scenarios.name: Defend the Rider's first mode makes the targeted creature indestructible against lethal combat damage
scenarios.ruling: A permanent with indestructible isn't destroyed by lethal damage, so the 2/2 survives 3 combat damage from the blocking 3/3; the same mode also grants hexproof until end of turn.

scenarios.name: Defend the Rider's first mode can target any permanent you control, not just a creature
scenarios.ruling: The mode reads "target permanent you control", so a land is a legal target and it gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.

scenarios.name: Defend the Rider's second mode creates one 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token
scenarios.ruling: The second mode creates exactly one token under its controller's control; a token whose text does not name it is named after its subtypes, so the token is a 1/1 Pilot.

scenarios.name: The Pilot token crews a Vehicle with crew 3 on its own
scenarios.ruling: The token's static ability makes it crew Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater, so the 1/1 alone pays crew 3; the crewed Bomat Bazaar Barge is then an artifact creature that can attack (a Hill Giant crewing the same Barge takes the defender from 20 to 15).
